verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you seven principles that prevent decline.

verses.pali: Katame ca, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniyā dhammā?
verses.english: And what are the seven principles that prevent decline?
They are the seven awakening factors.
The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniyā dhammā”ti.
verses.english: These are the seven principles that prevent decline.”
